subject: MPA stitch + legal milestone cadence for Novagene procurement
messages:
From: Sophie Clarke <sophie.clarke@novagene.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask — MAP + procurement sequencing (Novagene)

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the private deployment options. Procurement and legal asked me to pull together a tight mutual action plan so we can align on evidence windows and the dependency path between MSA / DPA / order form.

High level asks from Novagene:
- Target signature: week of Aug 23 (internal constraint)
- Need clear evidence and SOC/Security gating by Aug 9 to meet their operational cutover schedule
- DPA scoping: they want confirmation on data flows for embeddings + transient KV caching (legal will redline scope)

Can you share a quick staged MAP with milestones and owner assignments (legal, security, procurement, engineering), and a recommended sequencing for the MSA/DPA/order form so we can show our internal stakeholders the path to a safe Aug 23 sign?

I can loop in our procurement lead (Tom) if helpful — he’s on the thread below.

Thanks,
Sophie Clarke
VP, Platform Partnerships
Novagene Therapeutics

[attachment: Novagene_initial_requirements.pdf (pdf)]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Clarke <sophie.clarke@novagene.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — MAP + procurement sequencing (Novagene)

Hi Sophie — great to hear the team liked the demo. I sketched a condensed MAP and sequencing for signature that balances Novagene’s dates with the typical legal turnaround:

1) Week of Jul 26 — MAP v0.1: alignment call + owner RACI (we own MAP draft; Novagene to confirm internal approvers)
2) Jul 29–Aug 6 — Security evidence delivery & DPA scoping (we provide SOC2 summary, dataflow diagrams, and a DPA scope note)
3) Aug 2–Aug 12 — Legal redline cycle (MSA + DPA + order form) — two rounds anticipated
4) Aug 13–Aug 19 — Final signoff and DocuSign; execution week of Aug 23

Notes/risks:
- If legal requests substantive changes to processing clauses, it will push the DocuSign window — recommend we prepare a fallback order form with a limited data-processing appendix to expedite procurement signoff while DPA is finalized.
- We should proactively propose a limited pilot SLA for the first 90 days to address their reliability concerns and keep the commercial terms lean.

I’ll attach the MAP workbook and a DPA scoping note for their team to review. Karthik / Laura — can you review the sequencing and confirm the engineering evidence owners (SOC artifacts, infra diagram, and a small-run test plan)? If we can commit to delivering the evidence by Aug 6 we’re in good shape to hit Sophie’s dates.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

[attachment: Novagene_MAP_v0.3.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sophie Clarke <sophie.clarke@novagene.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — MAP + procurement sequencing (Novagene)

Thanks Rachel — read through the MAP and added technical owners & a small-batch evidence plan. Key items from infra side:

- Evidence bundle (deliver by Aug 6): SOC2 summary, network diagram showing VPC peering options, dataflow for embeddings + KV cache retention policy, and a 2-hour live test runbook (we can timebox to avoid long ops windows).
- DPA-scope: we’ll propose an appendix that limits persistence of embeddings to 0 (transient-only) and documents the KV cache TTL behavior — this usually keeps legal comfortable and avoids a lengthy DPA negotiation.
- Order form strategy: include a staged consumption commitment (90-day pilot with capped spend) so procurement can approve payment terms quickly while legal finalizes the DPA.

I also created a fallback lane: if Novagene’s legal insists on on-prem-only data residency, we’ll propose a private deployment pilot (longer onboarding timeline) rather than block the overall deal. That would shift the signature window by ~3–4 weeks.

Laura — can you confirm whether procurement needs any special PO language for the pilot billing model?

-Karthik
Lead, Inference Operations
Redwood Inference

[attachment: DPA-scope-notes.pdf (pdf)]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Clarke <sophie.clarke@novagene.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@novagene.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — MAP + procurement sequencing (Novagene)

Sophie / Tom — attaching the MAP workbook (v0.3) with owners, the DPA scoping note, and a draft order form optimized for a capped 90-day pilot. Quick summary of ask for your internal stakeholders:

- Action: review MAP owners tab and confirm approvers for legal/security/procurement by Jul 30
- Action: confirm whether they accept the transient-embeddings appendix (recommended) or require persistent-storage language
- Action: procurement (Tom) to confirm preferred billing path for a capped pilot (PO vs. card) and any PO language requirements

If we get confirmations by Jul 30 and we deliver the evidence bundle on Aug 6, legal can complete a single-round redline and we can keep the signature target week of Aug 23. If any item is delayed (approver identification or evidence delivery) we’ll rebaseline the MAP and propose an Aug 30 fallback.

Next step — 30-minute alignment call (Thursday Jul 29, 10am PT) to walk the MAP and evidence plan. I’ll send a calendar invite once I have confirmation from Novagene.

Cheers,
Rachel
